entries.title: Tree-of-Experience: Hierarchical Experience Management for Self-Evolving Agents
entries.summary: Tree-of-Experience organizes an agent's accumulated experience as a shared hierarchy of reasoning perspectives and paths, with reliability updated from environmental outcomes; it is a direct architecture for turning interaction history into reusable self-evolution rather than a flat episodic memory.

entries.title: Critic Experience Bank: Self-Evolving Step-Level Confidence Estimation for LLM Agents
entries.summary: Critic Experience Bank lets an agent's critic improve from its own execution history by storing hindsight pseudo-labels for productive and unproductive steps and retrieving analogous experiences before future actions, without critic training or ground-truth step labels.

entries.title: Reinforcement Learning for Self-Improving Agent with Skill Library (SAGE)
entries.summary: SAGE uses Skill Augmented GRPO, sequential rollouts, and a skill-integrated reward so useful skills discovered on earlier tasks become reusable assets on later tasks; on AppWorld it improves completion while reducing interaction steps and generated tokens.

entries.title: Universal Transformers for Circuit Computations: Perfect Length Generalization in Tiny Transformers
entries.summary: A 280-parameter universal-transformer construction iteratively performs depth-1 circuit reductions with autonomous halting, giving provably correct Boolean-expression evaluation at arbitrary depth and perfect length generalization on several algorithmic benchmarks.

entries.title: RecurrentGPT: Expressive Depth through Recurrent Modulation in Transformers
entries.summary: RecurrentGPT brackets a shared recurrent core with fixed prelude and coda blocks and gates each depth recurrence, showing that adaptive layer reuse can approach dense-transformer quality with substantially fewer parameters and lower decoding memory.

entries.title: T²MLR: Transformer with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence
entries.summary: T²MLR carries a cached middle-layer representation from the previous token into an earlier layer of the current token, preserving latent computation across decoding steps; recurrence over only a small middle block can outperform full-layer recurrence and can retrofit pretrained models.

entries.title: Retrieval-Augmented Decision Transformer: External Memory for In-context RL
entries.summary: RA-DT equips a Decision Transformer with an external memory of past sub-trajectories and retrieves only experiences relevant to the current state, extending in-context reinforcement learning to longer tasks without packing entire episodes into the context window.

entries.title: Lifelong In-Context Learning with Transformers Requires Parametric Forms of Attention
entries.summary: This paper argues that lifelong transformer learning needs parametric attention—such as linear attention, fast weights, state-space mechanisms, or test-time-training layers—that can continually absorb context into fixed-size learned state instead of an ever-growing KV cache.

entries.title: ELLA: Efficient Lifelong Learning for Adapters in Large Language Models
entries.summary: ELLA uses selective subspace de-correlation to protect high-energy task-specific adapter updates while leaving residual directions available for forward transfer, yielding replay-free continual adaptation with memory and compute that stay constant as tasks accumulate.

entries.title: Self-Improving Transformers Overcome Easy-to-Hard and Length Generalization Challenges
entries.summary: Standard Transformers iteratively generate and learn from their own solutions on progressively harder instances, enabling dramatic easy-to-hard and length generalization—including 10-digit to 100-digit addition—without changing the model architecture.

entries.title: End-to-End Test-Time Training for Long Context
entries.summary: TTT-E2E turns a sliding-window Transformer into a model that keeps learning during inference via next-token prediction, compressing long context into its weights while meta-learning an initialization designed to adapt efficiently at test time.

entries.title: Learning to (Learn at Test Time): RNNs with Expressive Hidden States
entries.summary: Test-Time Training layers make the recurrent hidden state itself a learnable model—either linear or an MLP—and update it with self-supervised learning on the incoming test sequence, making online adaptation a first-class sequence-modeling primitive.
